content.text: In this Meghalaya Trip you will explore nature of northeast India and is mostly untouched. Northeast India is a treasure scape for explorers, thanks to its spinning hills and valleys, waterfalls, culture, traditions, and life celebrations.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Visit Umiam Lake, also known as Barapani, Meghalaya's largest man-made lake
Witness the famous Elephant Falls and the stunning view of Shillong Peak
Visit the cleanest village in Asia, Mawlynnong
Enjoy boating on the crystal clear Umngot River
Drive to Cherrapunji and see the beautiful Waterfalls and caves
Visit the well-known Sankardev Kalakshetra Science Museum of Guwahati
A enjoyable boat cruise on the massive Brahmaputra River

days.title: Day 1 : Guwahati to Shillong
items: You will be met and brought to Shillong after arriving at Guwahati Airport or Station.
View Umiam Lake, also known as Barapani, Meghalaya's oldest mannered lake, tucked among sylvan hills ornamented with Khasi pines and beautiful beauty, along the trip.
A trip to the Elephant Falls and the calm Shillong Peak will be beneficial.
Shopping at the Police Bazar would be an excellent choice because you have the evenings free to explore the countryside at your leisure.
Check in at your hotel in Shillong.

days.title: Day 2 : Journey to the Mawlynnong and Dawki
items: After breakfast, begin your journey to Mawlynnong and take in the gorgeous scenery.
Visit Umngot River to see the splendour of the world's cleanest river.
The world's oldest Living Root Bridge and the Balancing Rock visit.
The viewpoint in Bangladesh would be the next stop for the day.
Check in at your accommodation at Dawki.

days.title: Day 3 : Dawki to Cherrapunjee
items: Following breakfast, leave for Cherrapunjee.
Witness Seven Sisters Falls and Nohkalikai Falls in Cherrapunjee.
Then, within Mawsmai Cave, have a relaxing cave ramble. The limestone cave is a natural beauty with many different architecture.
Arwah Cave, Garden Cave, Dainthlen Fall, Wei Sawdong, and the Ramakrishna Mission are among the other attractions to visit.
The Mawkdok Dympep Valley observation point in Sohra provides a beautiful view of the Hills.
Return to Shillong and check in at your hotel.

days.title: Day 4 : Guwahati Sightseeing
items: After breakfast, drive to Guwahati for a day of sightseeing.
Begin by visiting the Sankardev Kalakshetra Science Museum, which showcases Assam's cultural variety.
Along the trip, there are options for a Brahmaputra Cruise and a Dolphin Sighting on the Bridge.
For the evening, a trip to the local markets would suffice.
Thereafter check in at your hotel or lodge in Guwahati.

days.title: Day 5 : Departure
items: Today we will drop you to Guwahati Airport/ Railway Station.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
